title: Ode to the Riemann Hypothesis — Symphony in 53-EDO
description: A ~15-minute (900s) stage-independent 4-movement 53-EDO symphony (52–168 BPM): I. The Primes (Curiosity: playful 118–136 BPM chamber colors, 4:5:6:7:9:11 bright harmonies, 5 & 7-beat hockets, Sieve of Eratosthenes & Structure 1 Prime Curiosity Hook); II. Analytic Continuation (Through the Mirror: 88–114–66 BPM rubato waves, both 53-EDO diesis rotations, Structure 2 Functional Mirror Wedge xi(s)=xi(1-s) & palindrome, First Nontrivial Zero); III. A Century of Small Progress (72–136–60 BPM: C-minor Passacaglia Structure 3A, Fugato, Selberg subito pp barrier, Structure 3B Montgomery–Odlyzko Pair-Correlation Riff, fracturing human motifs & G+++7 step-24 Unresolved Summit); IV. The Herald, The Oracle, Triumph & Melancholy for Humanity (Bamboo-Synth shakuhachi The Herald & The Oracle at 152 & 168 BPM snap-fitting all structures, 122 BPM Cathedral Pipe Organ + tutti Proof Triumph, and 52 BPM ppp–mp human cello/english_horn 16:15 & -1 comma farewell beneath an eternal beatless 53-EDO harmonic halo).
